lines.cap: Square holes kept ripping open. So now, every hole they make is round.
lines.say: Square holes kept ripping open. So now, every hole they make is round.

lines.cap: 1952. The de Havilland Comet, the world's first jet airliner. Fast, sleek, and full of square-ish windows.
lines.say: 1952. The de Havilland Comet, the world's first jet airliner. Fast, sleek, and full of square-ish windows.

lines.cap: Then, in 1954, two Comets broke apart in mid air, within months.
lines.say: Then, in 1954, two Comets broke apart in mid air, within months.

lines.cap: Engineers put a whole plane in a giant water tank, and pumped it up and down, again and again, like real flights.
lines.say: Engineers put a whole plane in a giant water tank, and pumped it up and down, again and again, like real flights.

lines.cap: It ripped open at a sharp corner near the top. Cracks had started at corners, where stress piles up.
lines.say: It ripped open at a sharp corner near the top. Cracks had started at corners, where stress piles up.

lines.cap: A rounded corner spreads that stress out smoothly. No weak point.
lines.say: A rounded corner spreads that stress out smoothly. No weak point.

lines.cap: So today, every window, door and hatch on a plane has rounded corners.
lines.say: So today, every window, door and hatch on a plane has rounded corners.
